## Core Technical Disciplines

- **Cybersecurity & SOC Operations**: Security Operations Center (SOC) analysis, SIEM administration, threat intelligence monitoring, malware analysis, network security, phishing classification, and secure software development lifecycle (SSDLC).
- **AI & Machine Learning Engineering**: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), LangChain, FAISS vector indexing, Scikit-learn ensemble modeling, Pandas, SHAP tree explainability, NLP feature extraction, and Sentence Transformers (`all-MiniLM-L6-v2`).
- **LLMs, Inference & Automation**: Groq LLaMA 3.1 / 3.3 integration, Anthropic Claude API, OpenAI GPT-4o, prompt engineering, Docker, Linux/Bash system scripting, and FastAPI backend services.
- **Full-Stack Application Development**: Python, TypeScript, React 18/19, Next.js (App Router), Vite, Tailwind CSS, Streamlit, SQLite, and MongoDB Atlas.

## Featured Production Projects

1. **EduSathi** (Full-Stack AI Study Companion):
   - 4-stage RAG architecture (PDF ingestion, recursive character chunking, FAISS vector search, Groq LLaMA inference).
   - Features dual-portal RBAC (Student & Faculty/Admin) tailored for Indian university curricula.
   - [Case Study](https://muzzyy.me/projects/edusaathi/) | [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/Not-muzzyy/edusaathi)

2. **Mini-SIEM AI** (SOC Threat Monitoring Platform):
   - AI-powered SIEM platform replacing static regex with machine learning attack classification.
   - Provides SHAP (SHapley Additive exPlanations) for alert transparency and generates automated Groq narrative incident reports.
   - [Case Study](https://muzzyy.me/projects/mini-siem-ai/) | [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/Not-muzzyy/mini-siem-ai)

3. **Phishing Detector Advanced** (Multi-Vector ML Detection):
   - 4-layer cybersecurity pipeline analyzing URLs, text, HTML emails, and SMTP headers.
   - Achieves 97% accuracy, 96% precision, and 97% recall across English, Hindi, and Hinglish phishing vectors using 20+ extracted features.
   - [Case Study](https://muzzyy.me/projects/phishing-detector/) | [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/Not-muzzyy/phishing-detector-advanced)

4. **Virtual Pollution Intelligence Grid** (Geospatial AI Dashboard):
   - Real-time geospatial pollution telemetry built with Folium, Plotly, and Streamlit.
   - Features 7-day ML risk forecasting and hypothetical scenario simulations; built in 24 hours at Chakravyuha 3.0 Hackathon.
   - [Case Study](https://muzzyy.me/projects/virtual-pollution-grid/) | [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/Not-muzzyy/virtual-pollution-intelligence-grid)

5. **SafePush** (Developer Security Gate CLI):
   - Plugin-based pre-commit and CI/CD security scanner orchestrating Semgrep, Gitleaks, and Trivy to catch vulnerabilities, secrets, and risky AI code before production.
   - [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/Not-muzzyy/safepush)
